$description: Color tokens as implemented in the Revenue Health Matrix Zoom Explorer. These are the Matrix's per-system diagnostic colors, not (yet) a general Marketplace Maven brand palette — see BRAND-FOUNDATIONS-TODO.md.

softTintFormula.$description: The 'soft' background tint per system is not hand-picked — it's derived from the system's hex via HSL, preserving hue so each system stays visibly distinct instead of collapsing to the same pale off-white.
softTintFormula.algorithm: convert hex to HSL, cap saturation at 65%, fix lightness to 93%
